class.name: ICloudKV
class.brief_description: Reads and writes small values to iCloud Key-Value Storage.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the value stored under [param key], or an empty string if no value exists for that key.

method.name: set_value
method.description: Stores [param value] under [param key], overwriting any existing value, and requests an immediate synchronize. Returns [code]true[/code] on success.
